sn1.32:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn1.32:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā Satullapakāyikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu. || 3.
sn1.32:1.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.32:3.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imā gāthayo abhāsi || ||
sn1.32:6.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi ||
sn1.32:9.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imā gāṭhāyo abhāsi ||
sn1.32:12.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn1.32:12.2: Kassa nu kho Bhagavā subhāsitan ti || ||
sn1.32:13.1: Sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena || api mamam pi suṇātha || ||
sn1.32:14.4: kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti || || 8.
sn1.32:15.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavantaṃ gāthaya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn1.32:16.4: kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti || || 9. Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ devataṃ, gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn1.32:18.2: kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti || || 1. Sāvatthi ārāme || || 2.
